name: sontool-foundation
description: Experimental document foundation for SonTool v3.0

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run validate -- examples/landing.sjg examples/scroll.sjg examples/choice.sjg examples/runtime/landing.sjg examples/runtime/scroll.sjg examples/runtime/choice.sjg
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild demo/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/demo/main.js && node scripts/build-demo.mjs
